releases.body:
## turnstile v0.8.0

This release is about turnstile getting out of the way — and owning the host it runs on. Enforcement can now be suspended at runtime with two typed prompt markers, without config surgery or a restart; a session-end summary replaces the silence when a session goes idle; and the plugin now detects an incompatible opencode host at startup instead of misbehaving on one.

### New: gate suspend/resume (`TURNSTILE OFF:` / `TURNSTILE ON:`)

```text
TURNSTILE OFF: working through a prototype stretch
```

A user-typed `TURNSTILE OFF:` suspends blocking for the session: gate decisions keep being computed and journaled but never throw `BLOCKED` — observe-like, not blind — and all earned state clears. `TURNSTILE ON:` resumes enforcement with a fresh task scope; no credit earned while suspended rehydrates. Suspension restores from the journal tail, so a restart mid-suspension does not silently re-enforce, and a `refused:true` entry is replay-inert so the kill switch cannot be bypassed by its own journal row. The literals are config keys (`suspendMarker` / `resumeMarker`), and `allowSuspend: false` refuses both markers with a journaled diagnostic — deliberately not an agent-dispatchable off switch: the markers are honored only from admitted user prompts. A thin skill (`turnstile-suspend`, installed by `npm run init`) documents the markers, and `opencode-turnstile status` gains a per-session suspension column (#212, issue #184).

### New: host-compat detection

At setup, turnstile evaluates the running opencode version against a declared compatibility window (≥2.0.22, <3.0.0) and fails open — compatible, incompatible, or unknown — surfacing a verdict toast instead of silently misbehaving on an untested host. The tested list now includes 2.2.0 (#210, issue #178).

### New: session-end summary

When a session goes idle, one recap line reports what the pipeline verified: test-claims credited, premature dispatches blocked, waivers spent — with the journal path named. `sessionSummary` ships `quiet` (silent for zero-activity sessions); `on` always prints, `off` restores the old silence (#208, issue #177).

### Fixed

- `fix(install)`: refresh the ledger version stamp on content-identical upgrades (#206, issue #203)
- `fix(config)`: an explicit empty `bareOutput` resolves as unset instead of trapping the bare-output gate (#204, issue #191)

### Notes

Zero runtime dependencies, as always. Full docs: [README](https://github.com/edseabolt/turnstile#readme), [usage](docs/usage.md), [architecture](docs/architecture.md), [SECURITY](SECURITY.md).

## turnstile v0.7.0

The journal leaves the machine. This release ships the evidence surface end to end: summarize a task's verified pipeline record, publish it as a sticky PR comment, and — as of this release — the repo that builds turnstile runs all of it on its own pull requests.

### New: `opencode-turnstile evidence`

```sh
npx opencode-turnstile evidence --task latest --out .turnstile/evidence.json
```

Folds the journal's replay window into a shareable `turnstile-evidence/v1` document: derived counts, canonical marker lines, and shas only — session IDs, prompts, and command text are absent by construction. `--validate` re-checks a committed artifact in CI; `--format markdown` renders the sticky-comment body. The `review` section reports against the ensemble bar the runtime credits at (two unwaived reviewer dispatches under `reviewEnsemble: "enforce"`, one under `"advise"`) — a refusal stamp keeps it red, a human release satisfies it.

### New: sticky PR-comment Action

`examples/turnstile-evidence.yml` — copy into your repo's `.github/workflows/`. Two jobs, two trust levels: a `pull_request` validate job with read-only permissions, and a `pull_request_target` publish job that runs base-context code with `pull-requests: write`, no checkout, and no run step — it reads the committed artifact through the Contents API, asserts two byte invariants, and upserts exactly one comment keyed on `<!-- turnstile:evidence -->`. This release's pin (`opencode-turnstile@0.7.0`) is the first published version with the `evidence` subcommand; earlier pins exit 2.

### Field-tested on itself

Turnstile's own repo runs the evidence workflow on its PRs: the badge posted on [#197](https://github.com/edseabolt/turnstile/pull/197) is the live demo, screenshot in the README. The demo caught two real Actions-runtime bugs before any consumer did — the `github.paginate` Promise misuse and a `find`-vs-`null` guard — both fixed here.

### Fixed

- `fix(evidence)`: review bar derives from `reviewEnsemble` (the credit rule), not `maxReviewerRounds` (the dispatch cap); ensemble fold is last-wins over running counts, honoring refusal stamps and human releases — a fully-credited task can no longer render `reviewer 2/4` red
- `fix(evidence)`: sanitize folded marker fields, guard validate crash paths, forged-green bypass closed (#193)
- `fix(markers)`: guard parser regexes against broadening drift in check-markers (#194)
- `fix(install)`: copy-mode installs the full `src/` tree and verifies plugin load (#195)

### Notes

Zero runtime dependencies, as always. Full docs: [README](https://github.com/edseabolt/turnstile#readme), [usage](docs/usage.md), [architecture](docs/architecture.md), [SECURITY](SECURITY.md).

## Added

- **`gitGates.emptyDiffExempt`** (default **true**; `false` is the strict opt-out) — an opt-out for the new empty-diff exemption that lets the landing gate release `git push` commands whose every refspec resolves to the same commit as its upstream ref (ref equality via `git rev-parse`). Journaled as `{type:"tool", tool:"bash", landing:true, exempt:"empty-diff"}`. Frictionless by default: the probe releases only pushes git proves land nothing, so review of real work is unaffected.
  - Fail-toward-strict: force flags (`--force`/`-f`/`--force-with-lease`), `--mirror`, `--tags`, explicit shas/ranges, detached HEAD, and unresolvable upstreams all still gate; a branch **behind** its upstream never qualifies (ref equality, not ahead-count) — a force/rewind bypass was caught by the reviewer ensemble and closed before landing (#182).
  - New `src/empty-diff.ts` boundary (static `planPushRefs` + total git-side probe through a child_process seam), DI via `LandingGateCapability.isEmptyDiff`, wired in `hooks-core.ts`.

## Docs

- architecture.md module-map row for `empty-diff.ts`; d01/d03/d04 diagrams + SVGs updated; AGENTS.md boundary list; README/usage/schema/example JSON synced.
- Branching model: `dev` is the default, protected development branch; `main` is release-only, promoted by dev→main PR.

## Verification

- 962/962 tests, 100% line/branch/function coverage (`npm run ci` green).
- Full pipeline: plan approved, reviewer ensemble 2/2 (one CRITICAL force-rewind finding fixed pre-merge).

## Observe mode

New `observeSessions` config key: run turnstile in observe phase, where gate decisions are journaled without blocking, so you can evaluate the pipeline's verdicts before letting it enforce. Key changes (#180):

- `feat(config)`: add `observeSessions` config key for observe mode
- `feat(observe)`: journal observe phase entries and replay fold
- `feat(observe)`: suppress gate enforcement in hook bodies during observe phase
- `feat(observe)`: surface end-of-period observe summary via `opencode-turnstile status`
- `refactor(hooks)`: extract guarded dispatch pre-try guards (behavior byte-identical)
- docs: observe mode enforcement/journaling documented in `docs/architecture.md` and `docs/usage.md`; diagrams updated

## Packaging

- npm package published with provenance: `npm i opencode-turnstile@0.6.0`
- CI: 939 tests, 100% lines/branches/functions coverage

Documentation-focused release: the npm package now carries the value-first README (verified-agent-output pitch, "What you get" outcomes, demo artifact) from #174. No runtime behavior changes — package version bump only (#175).
